lines.description: A premier line of 100% certified organic nutrients, stimulants, and additives designed for natural and sustainable plant cultivation.

products.name: Bio-Grow
products.description: A complete liquid growth fertilizer made from 100% organic Dutch sugar beet extract that enriches soil microflora and supports vegetative development.

products.name: Bio-Bloom
products.description: An independent liquid organic fertilizer optimized for the flowering and fruiting phases, packed with phosphorus, potassium, and trace elements.

products.name: Fish-Mix
products.description: An organic fertilizer blend of marine fish emulsion and beet vinasse that conditions soil, boosts microbial growth, and accelerates early vegetative growth.

products.name: Top-Max
products.description: An organic flowering enhancer containing humic and fulvic acids that increases flower cluster size, improves nutrient uptake, and enhances crop sweetness.

products.name: Root-Juice
products.description: A root stimulant combining premium humic acids and cold-pressed seaweed to promote explosive root growth and maximize early nutrient absorption.

products.name: Alg-A-Mic
products.description: A revitalizing stress-relief additive derived from high-grade seaweed concentrate that helps crops recover from environmental changes, deficiencies, or pests.

products.name: Bio-Heaven
products.description: A highly concentrated plant energy booster containing hydrolyzed proteins and amino acids that enhances metabolism and eliminates toxins.

products.name: Acti-Vera
products.description: A 100% vegan botanical activator derived from aloe vera that protects the plant's immune system, activates metabolism, and optimizes nutrient uptake.

products.name: Calmag
products.description: A specialized calcium and magnesium supplement designed to correct and prevent deficiencies in soft water, coco, and hydroponic systems.

products.name: Bio-pH-
products.description: An aqueous organic pH down regulator formulated with citric acid to naturally adjust substrate acidity without disrupting beneficial soil microbes.

products.name: Bio-pH+
products.description: A humic acid-based organic pH up regulator crafted to increase pH levels safely while preserving the vitality of the substrate ecosystem.

lines.description: A global leader in high-performance plant nutrition, specialized substrate formulations, and additives engineered for soil, coco coir, and hydroponic cultivation systems.

products.name: Terra Vega
products.description: A complete base nutrient formulated for soil-based cultivation during the vegetative phase to promote strong shoot development and vigorous root growth.

products.name: Terra Flores
products.description: A specialized base nutrient designed for soil cultivation during the flowering phase to encourage robust bloom production and fruit formation.

products.name: Coco A & B
products.description: A two-part mineral base nutrient tailored specifically for growing in coco coir substrates, usable across both vegetative and flowering cycles.

products.name: Aqua Vega A & B
products.description: A two-part base nutrient engineered for recirculating hydroponic systems (like NFT or DWC) during the vegetative growth phase.

products.name: Aqua Flores A & B
products.description: A two-part base nutrient engineered for recirculating hydroponic systems during the flowering and fruiting phase.

products.name: Hydro Vega A & B
products.description: A two-part base nutrient formulation designed for run-to-waste (non-recirculating) hydroponic systems in vegetation.

products.name: Hydro Flores A & B
products.description: A two-part base nutrient formulation designed for run-to-waste (non-recirculating) hydroponic systems during bloom.

products.name: RHIZOTONIC
products.description: A powerful algae-based vegetative root bio-stimulant that accelerates new root expansion, increases plant resistance, and aids stress recovery.

products.name: CANNAZYM
products.description: A high-quality enzyme preparation that breaks down dead root material, improves soil architecture, and converts waste into bio-available nutrients.

products.name: CANNABOOST Accelerator
products.description: A yield-boosting metabolism accelerator that stimulates flower development, improves crop uniformity, and enhances natural flavor profile.

products.name: PK 13/14
products.description: A high-grade mixture of pure phosphorus and potassium applied during peak flowering to maximize bud mass and density.

products.name: Calmag Agent
products.description: A calcium and magnesium buffer supplement designed to harden soft or reverse osmosis water and prevent uptake imbalances.

products.name: pH- Grow
products.description: A nitric acid-based liquid regulator used to lower pH levels in the nutrient solution during the vegetative stage.

products.name: pH- Bloom
products.description: A phosphoric acid-based liquid regulator used to adjust and lower pH levels during the flowering stage.

products.name: pH+
products.description: A potassium hydroxide solution designed to raise pH levels safely in nutrient reservoirs.
